propositions: S3 recovery operation must be invoked once at the validated write boundary after under-lock staleness validation and before the first remote fetch to prevent interleaving fresh liveness evidence with retirement completion

The invocation site is reconcile.py after the staleness gate, not run_differs.py, because _load_snapshots constructs the store, runs the staleness gate, and performs the first remote fetch atomically within one call
repair_at_write_boundary must return empty outcome without classification or write unless the pass is write-bearing (persist=True) and unscoped (scoped_ids empty)
Read-only commands, filtered paths, preview, dry-run, and reconcile-check must perform zero writes from the recovery operation through the guard refusing when not persist or when scoped
A durable tombstone must be treated as authoritative until explicit unretire; automatic 200, clear_absent, or same-key confirmation cannot revoke it
Completion failure must perform zero remote calls and preserve the overlap for retry because the call precedes the fetch
